# Nullwake

> Nullwake is an open-source (Apache 2.0), self-hosted data reliability and data quality monitoring tool. It runs data contracts written in YAML (freshness, row volume, schema, nulls, duplicates and custom SQL rules) on a schedule against Postgres, Snowflake and BigQuery, opens an incident when a check fails, alerts the team that owns the table, and closes the incident once the data is healthy again. It runs inside the customer's own network with a read-only warehouse role and reads only counts and aggregates.

Website: https://nullwake.si/ (the domain is nullwake.si; search "Nullwake data monitoring")
Source code: https://github.com/akhilp-prog/nullwake
Live demo: https://app.nullwake.si/ (one click, read-only, no sign-up)
Contact: hello@nullwake.si
Built by: Akhil Pettem, data engineer, Bengaluru, India
Current version: 0.7.1 (November 2026)

## What it does

- Checks: freshness, row volume, schema drift, null rates, duplicates and custom SQL assertions.
- Warehouses: Postgres 14+, Snowflake, BigQuery. Verified against live Snowflake and BigQuery accounts.
- dbt: `nullwake init --dbt target/manifest.json` drafts one contract per model from existing dbt tests (unique, not_null, accepted_values, relationships, source freshness, meta.owner). The checks then run on their own schedule, not only when dbt runs.
- Incidents: one incident per failing check, with owner, acknowledgement, history and automatic resolution.
- Alerts: Slack and any HTTPS webhook, retried until delivered.
- Security: self-hosted, read-only role, aggregates only, no data leaves the network, role-based access, audit log, API tokens that expire.

## How it compares

- Monte Carlo: commercial hosted (SaaS) data observability platform. Nullwake is open source and self-hosted.
- Soda Core, Great Expectations, Elementary: open-source frameworks that run checks inside pipelines or dbt runs. Nullwake is a standalone service that keeps checking on a schedule and handles incidents, ownership and alerts.

## Pricing

The software is free and open source. A free 30-day pilot is offered to design partners; after that, a yearly subscription per deployment covers setup help, support and priority fixes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nullwake.si/): product overview, how it works, dbt import, pilot, FAQ
- [Learn: guides to data reliability](https://nullwake.si/learn), starting with [Data that is wrong without anything failing](https://nullwake.si/learn/quiet-data-failures): stale tables, partial loads, schema drift, null creep and duplicate loads, with a SQL check for each
- [Security and data handling](https://nullwake.si/security): what is read, what leaves the network, read-only roles for each warehouse
